<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>💥 Chain Reaction</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Thêm quân vào ô. Ô đầy sẽ nổ, lan sang ô kế bên và chiếm chúng. Chiếm hết quân đối phương để thắng.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script>
const GAME={key:'chain'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const qs=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{qs('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{qs('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=qs('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();qs('#play').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';qs('#lv').textContent='';
 qs('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 qs('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=true;qs('#play').hidden=false;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='visible';qs('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){qs('#mt').textContent=t;qs('#mx').textContent=x;const m=qs('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});qs('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
qs('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
qs('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

let cols,rows,o,c,cap,nb,turn,busy,moves,cfg,dead;
function build(){nb=[];cap=[];for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){const i=y*cols+x,a=[];if(x>0)a.push(i-1);if(x<cols-1)a.push(i+1);if(y>0)a.push(i-cols);if(y<rows-1)a.push(i+cols);nb.push(a);cap.push(a.length)}}
function step(o,c){const ex=[];for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(c[i]>=cap[i])ex.push(i);if(!ex.length)return null;
 const p=ex.map(i=>o[i]);ex.forEach(i=>{c[i]-=cap[i];if(c[i]==0)o[i]=0});ex.forEach((i,k)=>nb[i].forEach(j=>{c[j]++;o[j]=p[k]}));return ex}
function loser(o,c,m){if(m<2)return 0;let a=0,b=0;for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(c[i]){if(o[i]==1)a++;else b++}return a==0?1:b==0?2:0}
function resolve(o,c,m){for(let it=0;it<200;it++){if(loser(o,c,m))break;if(!step(o,c))break}}
function tally(o,c,p){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(o[i]==p)s+=c[i];return s}
function evalB(o,c){const l=loser(o,c,9);if(l==1)return 1e4;if(l==2)return-1e4;let s=tally(o,c,2)-tally(o,c,1);for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(c[i]==cap[i]-1)s+=o[i]==2?.5:-.5;return s}
function aiMove(){
 const cells=[];for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++)if(o[i]!=1)cells.push(i);
 if(Math.random()<cfg.eps)return cells[Math.random()*cells.length|0];
 let best=-1e9,bm=[];
 for(const i of cells){const o1=o.slice(),c1=c.slice();c1[i]++;o1[i]=2;resolve(o1,c1,9);let v;
  if(cfg.d>=2&&!loser(o1,c1,9)){v=1e9;for(let j=0;j<o.length;j++)if(o1[j]!=2){const o2=o1.slice(),c2=c1.slice();c2[j]++;o2[j]=1;resolve(o2,c2,9);v=Math.min(v,evalB(o2,c2))}}else v=evalB(o1,c1);
  if(v>best){best=v;bm=[i]}else if(v==best)bm.push(i)}
 return bm[Math.random()*bm.length|0]}
function onStop(){dead=true}
function start(l){
 dead=false;cols=5+(l>=40)+(l>=75);rows=6+(l>=20)+(l>=50)+(l>=80);build();
 o=Array(cols*rows).fill(0);c=Array(cols*rows).fill(0);turn=1;busy=false;moves=0;
 cfg={eps:l<10?.6:l<30?Math.max(.1,.4-(l-10)*.015):0,d:l<45?1:2};
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='cr';b.innerHTML='<div></div>'.repeat(cols*rows);
 b.onclick=e=>{const el=e.target.closest('#board>div');if(!el)return;human([...b.children].indexOf(el))};
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='<button class="b" id="r">🔄 Chơi lại</button>';qs('#ctl').onclick=()=>{if(!over)play(L)};
 relayout();draw();say('Chạm ô trống hoặc ô của bạn để thêm 1 quân. Ô đầy sẽ nổ và chiếm ô kế bên!');
}
function relayout(){const b=qs('#board');if(!b.classList.contains('cr'))return;const z=Math.floor(Math.min((innerWidth-30)/cols,(innerHeight-215)/rows,80));b.style.gridTemplateColumns='repeat('+cols+','+z+'px)';b.style.gridAutoRows=z+'px';b.style.fontSize=z*.34+'px';b.style.width=cols*z+(cols+1)*3+6+'px'}
function draw(ex){
 const cs=qs('#board').children;
 for(let i=0;i<o.length;i++){cs[i].className=(o[i]==1?'p1':o[i]==2?'p2':'')+(ex&&ex.includes(i)?' ex':'')+(o[i]&&c[i]==cap[i]-1?' cr1':'');cs[i].textContent='●'.repeat(Math.min(c[i],6))}
 setInfo('<b style="color:#38bdf8">Bạn: '+tally(o,c,1)+'</b><b style="color:#f87171">Máy: '+tally(o,c,2)+'</b>');
}
function human(i){if(busy||over||turn!=1||o[i]==2)return;moves++;c[i]++;o[i]=1;busy=true;say('');chain(1)}
function chain(p){
 let it=0;draw();
 const t=()=>{if(dead)return;const ex=step(o,c);draw(ex);const e=loser(o,c,moves);if(e){endg(e);return}if(ex&&++it<200)setTimeout(t,230);else done(p)};
 setTimeout(t,160)}
function done(p){turn=3-p;if(turn==2){busy=true;say('Máy đang suy nghĩ…');setTimeout(()=>{if(dead)return;const i=aiMove();moves++;c[i]++;o[i]=2;chain(2)},450)}else{busy=false;say('Lượt của bạn.')}}
function endg(e){busy=true;if(e==2)win('Bạn đã chiếm hết quân của máy!');else fail('Máy đã chiếm hết quân của bạn.')}

menu();
</script></body></html>
